results.title: Cabaret Boys
results.overview: A fringe therapist takes the world by storm with a galaxy-brained new approach to self-help called the Jackman Method. Through immersive sessions, he transforms wayward young men into semi-employable outsider artists—all from the comfort of his posh home office in New York City. When an unhinged ex-patient returns to his care and is chosen to headline the practice’s first ever cabaret night, the fallout is immense. Diva behavior, grueling rehearsals, and public scandal threaten to destroy not only the show but the Jackman Method itself.

results.title: Portraits
results.overview: The story follows Raghav, a troubled artist living in isolation after personal loss and betrayal. His life gradually intertwines with several other wounded souls, each carrying their own struggles and emotions. Through their connected lives, the narrative explores the complexities of the human mind and the search for inner peace.

results.title: El Mazaròl
results.overview: In early 1900s rural Trentino, Vanni and Agnese's life is upended by the arrival of Luzia, a young woman scarred by abuse. She claims to be a victim of the Mazaròl, a folkloric creature that kidnaps women in the woods.

results.title: The General
results.overview: In 1944, after years of longing, the Golian family finally welcomes a child-just weeks before the beginning of Slovak National Uprising led by Ján Golian. In Nazi-allied Slovakia, they must choose-fight for the nation or protect their son.

results.title: Nowhere Left to Hide
results.overview: A desperate woman starts over again in a small seaside town after faking her own death to escape from her abusive husband. But when he tracks her down, he starts to threaten the lives of those around her until she agrees to be with him forever.

results.title: Sampradayaini Suppini Suddapusaani
results.overview: After the accidental murder of a police sergeant, a man and his family are forced to cover up their tracks to avoid suspicion.

results.title: Lulk
results.overview: In a desperate attempt to pay off his family's debts, a metalworker stages a bank robbery that spirals into a hostage standoff.

results.title: Overman
results.overview: Overman, a fading superhero, takes a job with the government's Department of Public Security in an attempt to get back on his feet. While working alongside Pâmela, his loyal partner who is beginning to gain as much recognition as he has, Overman confronts his toxic masculinity and uncovers dark secrets involving the governor. Now, he must face his inner demons and an old enemy to prevent the city from plunging into irreversible chaos.

results.title: David Attenborough's 100 Years on Planet Earth
results.original_title: David Attenborough's 100 Years on Planet Earth
results.overview: A 90-minute special, broadcast from the Royal Albert Hall, London, celebrating Sir David Attenborough's groundbreaking career on the day of his 100th birthday.

results.title: Sunday Scaries
results.overview: Alex wakes up with a terrible case of "hangxiety," unaware his crazy night was caused by something far more paranormal… something his terrified friends know all too well.

results.title: Twin Snakes
results.overview: Like two snakes chasing each other’s tails, time wriggles forward and backwards in Lev Kalman and Whitney Horn’s surrealist satire. In 2001, a pair of young investigators wander a mansion that is haunted by both its eastern relics and their western collector. Meanwhile, in the present day, they are watched by The Therapists, two Lululemon-clad researchers following metaphysical wellness rituals. A mysterious lo-fi kaleidoscope, with cameos by Condoleezza Rice, Shah Jahan, and Brendan Fraser.

results.title: Chasing Kites
results.overview: When their apartment turns into a sea of paper dragons, a teenager faces the challenge of being there for his little brother without losing himself in the process.

results.title: Who Wants to Steal Your Beach?
results.overview: You know that beach you go to for a bit of rest? They want to take it away from you.  The so-called "Beach Amendment" (PEC das Praias)—championed in the Senate by Flávio Bolsonaro—could change who owns the Brazilian coastline, an area that belongs to everyone, by handing control over to hotels, resorts, and luxury condominium developments.  In practice, these developments would take over the entire beach area, leaving access to the sand and the sea exclusively to tourists—while you, as a Brazilian resident, would lose your access to the beach.  This model already exists in places like Cancún and Jamaica: there, the people in bikinis are foreigners, while the locals are the ones wearing uniforms and working. And that is exactly what could happen if Flávio Bolsonaro becomes president of Brazil.

results.title: Another League
results.overview: Spain, the 1970s. Although Francoist ideology remains deeply entrenched in society, a group of young trailblazers and an ambitious promoter are about to change the history of women’s football.

results.title: The Stop
results.overview: The city at night. A bus stop. A drunken man is dozing there. A young woman approaches. He asks her for help—to pour some cognac into his mouth. He cannot do it himself; his hands are occupied holding a grenade with a pulled pin—a weapon he came to possess purely by accident. The young woman calls the police. While waiting for help to arrive, a dialogue unfolds between them.

results.title: What Lives in Room 214?
results.overview: "What Lives in Room 214?" is a psychological horror featurette that follows actor Cory King who moves into a hotel for semi-successful actors, producers, and directors. The longer he stays, the more he notices things around him have never been what they seemed. "What Lives in Room 214?" tells a cautionary tale about the cost of fame.

results.title: BRICS, the Worlds New Masterminds?
results.original_title: Chine, Russie, Inde et Co, nouveaux maîtres du monde ?
results.overview: The BRICS countries now represent half of the world's population and 40% of GDP. Seen by some as an anti-Western coalition and by others as an economic counterweight, the BRICS are gaining momentum in their desire to impose a new world order. For now, they are maneuvering to "de-dollarize" the global economy and rally as many countries in the "global South" as possible to their model. Tomorrow, will they succeed in supplanting Western institutions and values with their parallel organizations, or will Europe manage to rebalance the playing field?

results.title: Imprint
results.overview: In a near-future where knowledge can be traded for citizenship, a desperate mother buys an immigrant’s expertise to give her daughter a competitive edge - at a cost she never imagined.
